nameOrigin: the melted rock in a volcano

pokedexEntries.go: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

pokedexEntries.si: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

pokedexEntries.cr: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

pokedexEntries.ru: MAGCARGO’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile - just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This POKéMON returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.

pokedexEntries.sa: MAGCARGO’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees F. Water is vaporized on contact. If this POKéMON is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

pokedexEntries.lg: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

pokedexEntries.em: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned MAGCARGO’s bodies into magma.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

pokedexEntries.hg: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

pokedexEntries.ss: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

pokedexEntries.x: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

pokedexEntries.y: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

pokedexEntries.or: Magcargo’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile—just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.

pokedexEntries.as: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Flames burst from gaps in its shell made of hardened magma.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

pokedexEntries.vi: According to folklore, a sudden increase in the wild Magcargo population heralds a volcanic eruption.
